data.name: Giosuetta
data.gender_notes: Giosuetta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Italian variation of Giuseppa, derived from the Hebrew name 'Yosef' meaning 'God will add'. 'Giosuetta' translates to 'Joseph's Goddess'. The name Giosuetta carries the meaning “Joseph's Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Giosuetta usually hope their child will grow to embody joseph's goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Devoted to Joseph and the spiritual growth he represents.
data.etymology: Giosuetta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joseph's Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Giosuetta total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ג'וסואטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'וסואטה הוא נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'אלוהים' ו'ישוע', שפירושן אלוהים יושיע או אלוהים הוא ישוע. השם הוא שילוב של שני המילים ומשמעותו היא שהאל הוא המושיע והוא ישוע המשיח.

in_greek.name: Γκιουσέττα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός σώζει, Θεός εἰς σωτηρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Γκιουσέττα προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὶς ἑβραϊκὲς λέξεις 'אלוהים' καὶ 'ישוע', ποὺ σημαίνει ὁ Θεὸς σώζει ἢ ὁ Θεὸς εἰς σωτηρία. Ἡ ἔννοια τοῦ ὀνόματος εἰς τὴν σωτηρίαν καὶ τὴν ἔλευσιν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς τὸν κόσμο.

in_latin.name: Giosuetta
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Giosuetta derivatur ex vocibus hebraicis 'אלוהים' et 'ישוע', quae significant Deum salvare vel Deum esse salvationem. Nomen hoc significationem habet quod Deus sit Salvator et Salvatio mundi per Jesum Christum.

in_english.name: Giosuetta
in_english.long_meaning: The name Giosuetta originates from the Hebrew words 'אלוהים' (El) meaning God and 'ישוע' (Yeshua) meaning salvation or God saves. It signifies that God is the savior and salvation through Jesus Christ. The name holds spiritual significance in Christian tradition, symbolizing faith and redemption. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its biblical roots and enduring relevance.

Her powerful rendition of 'Casta Diva' has been iconic, inspiring Italian artists and performers throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Giosuetta' embodies the belief in God's presence and intervention in our lives. As defined by its origin, the name 'Giosuetta' is symbolic of one's personal faith by recognizing God as an active participant in their existence. The acknowledgment of the divine essence adds to the depth and spiritual resonance of the name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Giosuetta, meaning "Josette" in Italian, carries the essence of the gentle and graceful Josephine or Joanna in Christianity. It symbolizes the strength and humility of these biblical women, embodying their unwavering faith and devotion to God.
